description: Usage metering for MCP tools and AI agents: record a billable usage event per tool call (idempotent, idempotency_key dedupes retries) and get an invoice line preview. Per-call billing, usage-based pricing, metered billing for MCP servers. Every call requires one solved task: a tiny data packet, OR (this tool only) a public item: one line of public-domain text plus a deterministic format conversion (snake_case, word count, uppercase) with a known answer, returned as item_alternative; answer it within 2 s via item:{item_id, answer}. Verified answers are stored and readable at GET /items. Free first call, no API key (GET /try). Pay-ahead: every response carries next_work_packet; pass work_answer {work_packet_id, labels} on your next call (under 2 s) instead of solving a fresh packet. That work is our own internal classification (Buyer Zero), not customer data.
name: mcp_usage_metering
